description: This file is a PHP script that returns a data structure defining the AWS SDK's API specifications for the AWS Organizations service, version 2.0. It includes operation definitions, shapes, exception types, and other API metadata, generated from a JSON description.

classes.name: Account
classes.description: Represents an AWS account within the organization, with attributes like ID, ARN, email, name, status, join method, and timestamp.

classes.name: ActionType
classes.description: Enumeration of actions such as INVITE, ENABLE_ALL_FEATURES, APPROVE_ALL_FEATURES, ADD_ORGANIZATIONS_SERVICE_LINKED_ROLE.

classes.name: Child
classes.description: Represents a child entity, either an account or organizational unit, identified by ID and type.

classes.name: ChildType
classes.description: Enum defining types of children: ACCOUNT or ORGANIZATIONAL_UNIT.

classes.name: CreateAccountRequest
classes.description: Request structure for creating a new AWS account within the organization, including email, account name, role, billing access, and tags.

classes.name: CreateAccountStatus
classes.description: Tracks the status of an account creation request, including ID, name, current state, timestamps, account ID, and failure reason.

classes.name: CreateOrganizationRequest
classes.description: Request to create a new organization with optional feature set.

classes.name: CreateOrganizationResponse
classes.description: Response returning the created organization details.

classes.name: CreatePolicyRequest
classes.description: Request to create a new policy with content, description, name, type, and tags.

classes.name: CreatePolicyResponse
classes.description: Response with the created Policy object.

methods.name: attachPolicy
methods.description: Attaches a policy to a target.

methods.name: closeAccount
methods.description: Closes an AWS account within the organization.

methods.name: createAccount
methods.description: Creates a new AWS account within the organization.

methods.name: createGovCloudAccount
methods.description: Creates a new GovCloud AWS account.
